x-lid.version_rule: MINOR: additive; no existing schema or entity file is changed
changes_from_as_received: fields readings_by and status_rule added (optional), for readings from more than one reader

title: attribute readings file
description: registry/attribute_readings.json: one entry per attribute field, written by an outside reader from abstracts only, under the contract declared in registry/DECLARED.json amendments 'claim/number split (abstract pass)' and 'NOT_ADDRESSED + reading queue'. The claim is the field's definition copied verbatim at reading time; the value is the field's stored value; claim_support and number_support are judged separately; each work read carries a quote of at most 25 words. The several-works aggregation rule (CONTRADICTED if any contradicts, else STATED if any states, else RELATED if any is related, else NOT_ADDRESSED; number STATED if any gives it) and the outcome mapping to provenance statuses are prose rules: scripts/reading_queue.py and the build scripts enforce them, this schema does not. Registry-file convention follows registry/sources.json: {note, readings}.

claim_support.description: STATED: the abstract states the claim in the field's definition. RELATED: on the subject, does not state the claim. CONTRADICTED: contradicts the claim or the number. NOT_ADDRESSED: the source does not address the field's claim (value kept, status PROPOSED, note 'citation does not address claim'). NOT_READ: no abstract was available for any work behind the field.

number_support.description: STATED: the abstract gives the field's number, or one that rounds to it, for the defined quantity. NOT_STATED: it does not.

claim.description: The field's definition, copied verbatim at reading time. sha256 of this string is the claim_sha256 in params.status_basis of the step the build script writes.

value.description: The field's stored value, as read. Never coerced; null when the field is null.

status.description: Outcome per the amendment-8 mapping: 'OBSERVED (basis: abstract)' when claim and number are both STATED; 'OBSERVED (basis: abstract)' for the claim with the number void UNMAPPED when claim STATED and number NOT_STATED; 'PROPOSED' when claim is RELATED, CONTRADICTED or NOT_ADDRESSED. Null when claim_support is NOT_READ: no new step is written.

note.description: Reader's note. Names works of the same string that were not read, and carries the amendment-9 note text where it applies.

source_id.description: Id in registry/sources.json: full lowercase sha256 of the exact source string.

pmid.description: PubMed id of the record read, as a string. Null when the work was identified in a second index without a PMID.

quote.description: Verbatim words from the abstract, at most 25 (the pattern counts whitespace-separated tokens and fails the file on a 26th word). Null only when claim_support is NOT_READ and nothing was read.

read.description: What was read. The declared pass is abstracts only; no full text. A different value means a different, separately declared pass.

reader.description: Who read. One reader, no second reading (declared limit of the pass).

readings_by.description: Readings side by side, one per reader. No reading is deleted or overwritten. The field-level claim_support, number_support and status are derived from these by the declared rule (definition = claim).

status_rule.description: How the field-level values were derived from readings_by.
